source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 15 (PDF 25-56), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Human Nervous System) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is coordination? (i) Name its two types in humans. (ii) Explain the role of receptors, the central nervous system and effectors in nervous coordination. (4 marks)
(Coordination kya hai? (i) Insanon mein is ki do qismein batayein. (ii) Nervous coordination mein receptors, central nervous system aur effectors ka kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Coordination: janwar ke aza aur nizamon ke kaam aapas mein jure hote hain taake har kaam (dil ki dharkan, saans, hazma) jism ki zaroorat ke mutabiq chale, aur janwar mahol ki tabdeeli mehsoos kar ke jawab de.

(i) Qismein: 1. Nervous coordination, nervous system electrical signals se control karta hai. 2. Chemical coordination, endocrine system control karta hai.

(ii) Nervous coordination ke hisse:
1. Receptors: aza, tissues ya cells (aankh, kaan, jild) jo stimuli yani bahar aur andar ki tabdeeliyan mehsoos karte hain. Yeh transducers hain, energy ki aik shakal doosri mein badalte hain (rods aur cones roshni ko nerve impulse mein), aur sensory neurons mein impulse banate hain jo CNS tak jata hai.
2. Central nervous system: control centre, brain aur spinal cord. Is ke associative neurons (inter-neurons) sensory neurons se impulse le kar amal karte aur motor neurons ke zariye effectors ko bhejte hain.
3. Effectors: muscles aur glands jo CNS ke impulse par jawab dete hain; muscles sukarte aur glands ratoobat banate hain.
Paigham ka raasta: receptors → sensory neurons → CNS (inter-neurons) → motor neurons → effectors; neurons kaam ki ikaai hain.

book_ref.quote: So, in nervous coordination, the path of a message (nerve impulse) consists of receptors

blocks.prompt:
2 What are neuroglia? Describe the formation and role of the myelin sheath, and explain the terms white matter, grey matter and nodes of Ranvier. (4 marks)
(Neuroglia kya hain? Myelin sheath ki banawat aur kirdar bayan karein, aur white matter, grey matter aur nodes of Ranvier ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Neuroglia (glial cells) nervous system ke khaas madadgar cells hain. Yeh neurons ko ghiza dete, fuzla hatate aur immunity dete hain.

Myelin sheath: do ahem glial cells, Schwann cells aur oligodendrocytes, bohat se neurons ke axons ke gird lipat kar myelin sheath (kai membrane tehon ka ghilaf) banate hain. Schwann cells peripheral nervous system mein aur oligodendrocytes CNS mein. Myelin sheath insulating ghilaf hai jo impulse ki tez tarseel mein madad deta hai. Jin neurons par yeh ho woh myelinated, jin par na ho woh non-myelinated.

White aur grey matter: CNS mein myelinated axons white matter; non-myelinated dendrites aur cell bodies grey matter banate hain. PNS mein dono qisam ke axons bandh kar nerves banate hain.

Nodes of Ranvier: myelinated neurons mein myelin sheath har 1 se 2 mm par chhote non-myelinated khalon se toot-ti hai; yeh nodes of Ranvier hain.

book_ref.quote: In the nervous system, there are special cells which support neurons

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the knee-jerk reflex, including the role of the hamstrings muscle. (4 marks)
(Knee-jerk reflex bayan karein, hamstrings muscle ke kirdar samait.)
blocks.explanation:
Knee-jerk aik reflex (foran, khud-ba-khud, ghair iradi jawab) hai jise reflex arc, sab se saada neural raasta, control karta hai.

1. Stimulus: ghutne ke neeche patellar tendon par hathori se thapki.
2. Receptor: ran ke quadriceps muscle ka receptor thapki mehsoos kar ke sensory neuron mein impulse banata hai.
3. Sensory neuron: impulse spinal cord tak le jata hai.
4. Motor neuron: spinal cord mein sensory neuron inter-neuron ke baghair seedha motor neuron ko impulse deta hai.
5. Effector: motor neuron impulse quadriceps tak le jata hai jo sukarta hai; ghutne par nichli taang seedhi ho kar aage jhatka khati hai.

Hamstrings ka kirdar: saath hi sensory neuron spinal cord mein aik inter-neuron ko chalata hai. Yeh chemicals nikal kar hamstrings ke motor neurons ko rokta hai, is liye taang seedhi hote waqt hamstrings dheele rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Knee-jerk is a reflex that occurs when someone hits the tendon below the knee

blocks.prompt:
4 What is resting membrane potential? Explain how fixed anions, the sodium-potassium pump and K⁺ leakage establish it. (4 marks)
(Resting membrane potential kya hai? Wazahat karein ke fixed anions, sodium-potassium pump aur K⁺ ka risao ise kaise qaim karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Resting neuron (jo signal nahi le ja raha) polarized hota hai: andar manfi, bahar musbat. Yeh membrane potential resting membrane potential (RMP) hai, taqreeban –70 mV; manfi nishan batata hai ke andar bahar se manfi hai.

Awamil:
1. Fixed anions: proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare manfi molecules andar zyada hain aur bahar nahi ja sakte.
2. Sodium-potassium pump: K⁺ andar 30 guna aur Na⁺ bahar 10 guna zyada hai. Pumps ATP kharch kar ke inhein gradient ke khilaf chalate hain; har do K⁺ andar par teen Na⁺ bahar, is liye andar zyada manfi hota hai.
3. K⁺ ka risao: kuch K⁺ ions K⁺ gates se bahar nikal jate hain.

K⁺ ka bahar jana aur manfi proteins ka andar rehna andar manfi aur bahar musbat charge ke sab se bare awamil hain.

book_ref.quote: In resting neurons, RMP is established by the following factors

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: andar bare manfi molecules qaid hain (fixed anions), pump har chakkar mein aik musbat charge zyada bahar bhejta hai (3 Na⁺ bahar, 2 K⁺ andar), aur K⁺ dheere dheere bahar risti hai. Teeno se andar manfi reh jata hai: –70 mV.

blocks.prompt:
5 What is an action potential? Describe the changes in membrane potential and ion movement during depolarization, repolarization and the return to RMP, and explain how the action potential is passed along the axon. (4 marks)
(Action potential kya hai? Depolarization, repolarization aur RMP par wapsi mein membrane potential aur ions ki harkat bayan karein, aur batayein ke action potential axon par aage kaise jati hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Jab neuron nerve impulse banata hai to aik hisse par membrane potential ulat jati hai (andar musbat); yeh active membrane potential ya action potential hai.

1. Depolarization: Na⁺ gates khulte aur Na⁺ tezi se andar aata hai; potential –70 mV se zero ki taraf ja kar 50 mV tak pohanchti hai. Yeh ulat-phair chhote hisse par taqreeban aik millisecond ke liye action potential banata hai.
2. Repolarization: Na⁺ gates band aur K⁺ gates khulte hain; K⁺ bahar ja kar andar ko phir manfi karta hai.
3. Hyperpolarization: tamam K⁺ gates band hone mein thori dair se potential thori der RMP se zyada manfi ho jati hai.
4. RMP par wapsi: thore refractory period ke baad sodium-potassium pump asal ionic taqseem bahal karta aur membrane –70 mV par aa jati hai.

Aage barhna: action potential asal mein safar nahi karti, dobara banti hai. Aik hisse ki action potential agle hisse ke liye depolarization ka stimulus hai, jo apni action potential banata hai jab ke pichla hissa RMP par wapas aata hai.

book_ref.quote: When a neuron becomes active (generates nerve impulse), the membrane potential at a region of neuron is reversed

blocks.prompt:
6 Answer about the nerve impulse along an axon. (i) Does the strength of an action potential change along an axon? (ii) Explain the factors that affect the velocity of a nerve impulse, with the speeds found in human neurons. (4 marks)
(Axon par nerve impulse ke bare mein jawab dein. (i) Kya axon par action potential ki taqat badalti hai? (ii) Nerve impulse ki raftar par asar dalne wale awamil insani neurons ki raftar ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Nahi. Axon ki lambai mein action potential ki taqat (amplitude) yaksan rehti hai; aakhir wali utni hi taqatwar hai jitni pehli. Sirf raftar badal sakti hai.

(ii) Awamil:
1. Qutr: axon ka qutr bara ho to raftar zyada.
2. Myelin: axon myelinated ho to raftar zyada. Myelinated axons mein action potential sirf nodes of Ranvier par banti aur node se node chhalang lagati hai. Yeh saltatory conduction sab se tez non-myelinated axons se 50 guna tak tez hai.
Insanon mein raftar: non-myelinated neurons 1 se 3 m/s; myelinated neurons 120 m/s tak.

book_ref.quote: However, the velocity of nerve impulse i.e., speed of conduction of action potential may vary

blocks.prompt:
7 How do inhibitory neurotransmitters act on the postsynaptic neuron? Describe GABA, glycine and endorphins, and explain why opium derivatives reduce pain. (4 marks)
(Inhibitory neurotransmitters postsynaptic neuron par kaise asar karte hain? GABA, glycine aur endorphins bayan karein, aur batayein ke opium ke derivatives dard kyun kam karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Tareeqa: inhibitory neurotransmitters impulse ke aage jane ka imkaan kam karte hain. Postsynaptic receptors se jurne par sodium ki jagah chloride channels khulte hain. Cl⁻ andar aa kar andar ko RMP se bhi zyada manfi karta hai; yeh hyperpolarization rokne wala asar hai.

1. GABA: CNS ka sab se ahem inhibitory neurotransmitter. Neural josh kam karta, jismani aur rawayye ke amal control karta, bechaini, dabao aur khauf ghatata aur sukoon aur neend laata hai. Bohat si sedatives GABA ko receptors se zyada jorti hain.
2. Glycine: khaas kar spinal cord, brainstem aur retina mein inhibitory.
3. Endorphins: dimagh ke neurons nikalte hain; dard ke paigham wale excitatory neurotransmitters ka nikalna kam karte hain, is liye dard ke signals dimagh tak nahi pohanchte.

Opium aur is ke derivatives, morphine aur heroin, dard kam karte hain kyun ke yeh endorphins jaise hain aur un ke receptors se asani se jur jate hain.

book_ref.quote: This hyperpolarization causes inhibitory effect

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain the normal action of acetylcholine at the neuromuscular junction and the effect of nerve gas on it. (4 marks)
(Neuromuscular junction par acetylcholine ka aam kaam aur us par nerve gas ka asar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aam kaam: acetylcholine excitatory neurotransmitter hai jo motor neurons neuromuscular junctions (motor neuron aur muscle fibre ke synapse) par nikalte hain. Yeh skeletal muscles ko sukarne par uksata hai. Phir acetylcholinesterase enzyme ise tor deta hai taake muscle dheela ho sake.

Nerve gas ka asar: nerve gas (sarin, tabun, soman) sakht zehreela chemical hai jo acetylcholinesterase ko rokta hai.
1. Acetylcholine nahi toot-ta aur jama hota hai.
2. Skeletal muscles zyada uksaye jate aur sukre rehte hain.
3. Agar diaphragm sukra rahe to insan saans nahi le sakta.
4. Doosre asraat: muscles ka pharakna, dauray, saans ki takleef aur aakhir maut.

book_ref.quote: The excitatory neurotransmitter acetylcholine is released by motor neurons at neuromuscular junctions

blocks.prompt:
9 Name four biogenic amines and give the source and functions of each. How are dopamine and serotonin linked with disorders? (4 marks)
(Chaar biogenic amines ke naam, un ka mamba aur kaam likhein. Dopamine aur serotonin ka bimariyon se kya talluq hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Biogenic amines excitatory neurotransmitters hain jo hormones ka kaam bhi karte hain.
1. Norepinephrine: CNS aur sympathetic nerves mein banta; neend, tawajjuh aur chaukasi control karta hai.
2. Epinephrine: adrenal glands aur brainstem mein nikalta; neend mein kirdar aur chaukas hone aur rehne mein madad.
3. Dopamine: dimagh ka neurotransmitter; jism ki harkat, motivation wali khushi aur jazbati uksahat control karta hai.
4. Serotonin: aant mein (taqreeban 90%) aur CNS mein (10%); bhook, neend, yaad-dasht aur seekhna, hararat, mizaaj, rawayya aur muscle sukarna control karta hai.

Bimariyan: dopamine wale neurons ki kharabi se Parkinson's ke kaanpte muscles. Serotonin wale neurons ki kam sargarmi se depression ho sakta hai; antidepressants serotonin ko cleft se hatne nahi detin aur depression kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Biogenic amines are excitatory neurotransmitters. They also function as hormones

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the basic organization of the human nervous system, including the divisions of the PNS. (4 marks)
(Insani nervous system ki bunyadi tanzeem bayan karein, PNS ki taqseem samait.)
blocks.explanation:
1. CNS: brain aur spinal cord, inter-neurons aur neuroglia se bane; brain cranium mein aur spinal cord vertebral column mein, dono meninges se dhake.
2. PNS: nerves aur ganglia. Cranial nerves (12 jore) brain se aur spinal nerves (31 jore) spinal cord se. Nerves axons ke taar numa majmue; ganglia CNS se bahar cell bodies ke majmue.
3. PNS ke raaste:
a. Sensory raaste: spinal aur cranial nerves ke sensory neurons jo receptors ko CNS se jorte hain.
b. Motor raaste: motor neurons jo CNS ko effectors se jorte hain. Do nizam:
- Somatic nervous system: skeletal muscles control karne wale motor neurons; iradi, magar reflex mein shaoor ke baghair.
- Autonomic nervous system: smooth muscles aur glands control karne wale motor neurons; ghair iradi (saans, dharkan, hazma). Is ke sympathetic aur parasympathetic hisse hain.

book_ref.quote: The human nervous system consists of central nervous system (CNS) and peripheral nervous system (PNS)

blocks.prompt:
11 The brain and spinal cord are protected and hollow. (i) Describe the three layers of meninges. (ii) Describe the ventricles of the brain and their function. (4 marks)
(Brain aur spinal cord mehfooz aur khokhle hain. (i) Meninges ki teen tehein bayan karein. (ii) Dimagh ke ventricles aur un ka kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Brain (cranium mein) aur spinal cord (vertebral column mein) teen jhilliyon wali meninges se dhake hain:
1. Dura mater: khopri aur vertebrae ke neeche sab se bahar moti teh; bari khoon ki naliyan.
2. Arachnoid: dura mater ke neeche patli teh; neeche ke cerebrospinal fluid aur dura mater ke khoon ke darmiyan rukawat.
3. Pia mater: bohat nazuk teesri teh; brain aur spinal cord se chipki aur capillaries se inhein ghiza deti hai.

(ii) Brain aur spinal cord khokhle hain, in mein maye se bhare khane (ventricles) hain. Chaar ventricles: do bare lateral cerebrum mein; teesra diencephalon mein daen aur baen thalamus ke darmiyan; chautha cerebellum aur brainstem ke darmiyan, spinal cord ki darmiyani nali se mila hua. Asal kaam cerebrospinal fluid banana aur gardish dena.

book_ref.quote: Both are covered with protective meninges which consists of three layers of membranes

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the cerebrum: its hemispheres, the four lobes with their functions, and the areas of the cerebral cortex. (4 marks)
(Cerebrum bayan karein: is ke hemispheres, chaar lobes aur un ke kaam, aur cerebral cortex ke areas.)
blocks.explanation:
Cerebrum: insani dimagh ka sab se bara hissa, bahar ki teh bohat tah-dar. Gehri naali (fissure) ise baen aur daen hemispheres mein bant-ti hai jo tah mein corpus callosum (axons ki patti) se jure hain. Har hemisphere jism ki mukhalif taraf se maloomat leta aur usi taraf motor hukm bhejta hai.

Har hemisphere ke lobes:
1. Frontal: khud par qaboo, mansooba bandi, dalail, mujarrad soch.
2. Parietal: sensory maloomat, jism aur mahol ki position ka shaoor, tawajjuh, harkat ki mansooba bandi aur amal.
3. Temporal: nazri yaad-dasht, zabaan samajhna aur jazbat ke liye sensory maloomat.
4. Occipital: nazar.

Cerebral cortex: grey matter ki tah-dar bahar wali teh, inter-neurons se bhari. Areas: motor (iradi muscles ko impulse), sensory (temporal lobe ka auditory cortex awaaz ke liye, occipital ka visual cortex aankh ke liye), association (aala zehni kaam, maslan zabaan baen taraf, visual-spatial daen taraf). Cortex ke neeche myelinated axons ka white matter cortex ke hisson aur doosre markazon ko jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the largest portion of human brain

blocks.prompt:
13 Answer about the middle and lower parts of the brain. (i) Describe the three divisions of the brainstem. (ii) Describe the diencephalon and its parts. (4 marks)
(Dimagh ke darmiyani aur nichle hisson ke bare mein. (i) Brainstem ke teen hisse bayan karein. (ii) Diencephalon aur is ke hisse bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Brainstem cerebrum ke neeche hai aur use spinal cord se jorta hai:
1. Midbrain: dekhne aur sunne ki maloomat aage bhejta; reticular formation jo hindbrain ko forebrain se jorti hai.
2. Pons: cerebral hemispheres aur cerebellum ke darmiyan impulses.
3. Medulla oblongata: relay centre aur dil ki dharkan, saans ki raftar aur doosre homeostatic kaamon ka control centre.

(ii) Diencephalon dimagh ke markaz mein gehra, brainstem ke upar aur cerebrum ke neeche (hemispheres ke darmiyan). Hisse:
1. Thalamus: sensory maloomat aur cerebrum ke darmiyan relay centre. Is ke do hisse jahan milte hain wahan pineal gland melatonin banata hai jo neend control karta hai.
2. Hypothalamus: andaruni aza ke kaam jorta; hararat, bhook aur sairi, pyaas aur jazbat control karta; pituitary gland ko chalata jo bohat se doosre endocrine glands control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The cerebrum is connected to the spinal cord through brainstem

blocks.prompt:
14 Answer about the emotional and movement centres of the brain. (i) Describe the limbic system and its parts. (ii) Describe the structure and functions of the cerebellum. (4 marks)
(Dimagh ke jazbati aur harkat ke markazon ke bare mein. (i) Limbic system aur is ke hisse bayan karein. (ii) Cerebellum ki banawat aur kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Limbic system: thalamus ke dono taraf, cerebrum ke bilkul neeche juri hui banawaton ka group. Is mein hypothalamus, amygdala, hippocampus aur qareeb ke hisse.
1. Amygdalae: temporal lobes mein gehri do badaam numa banawat; mohabbat, nafrat, ghussa, khauf, ghazab aur jinsi uksahat ke jazbat control karti hain.
2. Hippocampus: amygdala se peeche murte do 'seeng'; short-term se long-term memory mein maloomat pakki karta hai.

(ii) Cerebellum: dimagh ka doosra bara hissa, cerebral hemispheres ke neeche aur peeche. Banawat: cortex ki ghani tah-dar teh, neeche white matter. Kaam: muscles ki harkat murattab; muscles, tendons, joron, aankhon, kaanon aur doosre markazon se maloomat leta; jism ki position par amal kar ke posture control; tez aur jaari harkaat ko brainstem aur cortex ke saath mil kar murattab karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It includes the hypothalamus, the amygdala, the hippocampus, and several other nearby areas

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the structure of the spinal cord. (4 marks)
(Spinal cord ki banawat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Phailao aur hifazat: spinal cord neurons ki taar hai jo medulla oblongata se reerh ki haddi mein neeche jati hai; vertebral column aur meninges ki tehein iski hifazat karti hain.
2. Size: qutr 0.25 se 0.5 inch; cervical aur lumbar hisson mein zyada chora (jo bazu aur dhar, aur taangon ka sensory input aur motor output sambhalte hain).
3. Grey aur white matter: dimagh ki tarah magar ulti tarteeb. Andar H-numa (titli numa) grey matter, jis mein inter-neurons aur motor neurons ki cell bodies, neuroglia aur non-myelinated axons. Bahar myelinated axons ka white matter.
4. Darmiyani nali: andar maye se bhari nali, chauthe ventricle ka tasalsul.
5. Nerves: is se 31 jore spinal nerves nikalte hain, har aik dorsal (sensory) aur ventral (motor) jar se.
Kaam: jism aur dimagh ke darmiyan paighamon ki information highway.

book_ref.quote: The spinal cord is a cable of neurons extending from the medulla oblongata of brain down through the backbone

blocks.prompt:
16 Twelve pairs of nerves arise from the brain. (i) How many cranial nerves are there, and where do they arise? (ii) Classify the cranial nerves as sensory, motor and mixed, giving the major function of each. (4 marks)
(Dimagh se barah jore nerves nikalte hain. (i) Cranial nerves kitni hain aur kahan se nikalti hain? (ii) Cranial nerves ko sensory, motor aur mixed mein taqseem karein aur har aik ka bara kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Cranial nerves ke 12 jore hain. Pehle do (olfactory aur optic) cerebrum se, baqi 10 brainstem se. Kuch sensory, kuch motor aur kuch mixed (sensory aur motor dono axons).

(ii) Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: There are 12 pairs of cranial nerves

rows: I: soonghna; II: dekhna; VIII: sunna aur tawazun
III: aankh ki harkat; IV: aankh ka superior oblique muscle; VI: aankh ke lateral muscles (bahar dekhna); XI: gardan aur kandhon ke muscles; XII: zabaan ke muscles
V: chehre ki hiss, chabane ke muscles; VII: chehre ke tasurrat, zabaan ke aage ka zaiqa; IX: zabaan ke peeche ka zaiqa, nigalne ke muscles; X: dil, phephre aur hazme ke nizam samait bohat se aza

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the spinal nerves: their number, nature, roots and region-wise distribution. (4 marks)
(Spinal nerves bayan karein: tadaad, qisam, jaren aur hissa-war taqseem.)
blocks.explanation:
Tadaad aur qisam: spinal cord se ikattees (31) jore spinal nerves nikalte hain. Sab mixed hain aur spinal cord aur baqi jism ke darmiyan sensory aur motor maloomat le jate hain.

Jaren: har spinal nerve do chhoti jaron se nikalti hai.
1. Dorsal root: sensory neurons ke axons aur dendrites; sensory neurons ki cell bodies spinal cord se bahar dorsal root ganglia mein.
2. Ventral root: motor neurons ke axons; somatic motor neurons ki cell bodies spinal cord ke andar, ganglia mein nahi.
Dono jaren vertebral column chhorne se zara pehle mil jati hain.

Taqseem: 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral aur 1 coccygeal jora.

book_ref.quote: Each spinal nerve emerges from the spinal cord by two short branches or roots

blocks.prompt:
18 Compare the effects of the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems on different body parts. (4 marks)
(Sympathetic aur parasympathetic nervous systems ke jism ke mukhtalif hisson par asraat ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Sympathetic system (thoracic aur lumbar hisson ke motor neurons) dabao mein jism ko fight or flight ke liye tayyar karta hai. Parasympathetic system (brain, zyada tar vagus nerve, aur sacral hisse ke motor neurons) dabao ke baad is ka ulat kar ke aza ko normal karta hai. Asraat table mein.

book_ref.quote: This system antagonises the response of sympathetic nervous system after the threat or stress has passed

blocks.prompt:
19 Drugs affect nervous coordination. (i) Define drug, psychoactive drug and narcotic drug, with examples. (ii) What is meant by use and abuse of drugs? (4 marks)
(Drugs nervous coordination par asar karti hain. (i) Drug, psychoactive drug aur narcotic drug ki definitions misalon ke saath likhein. (ii) Drugs ke use aur abuse se kya murad hai?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Drug: khurak ke ilawa koi cheez jo bimari ya ghair maamooli halat se bachao, tashkhees, ilaj ya alamaat mein araam ke liye ho; drugs dimagh par asar kar ke mizaaj, shaoor, soch, ehsas ya rawayya badal sakti hain.
Psychoactive drug: dimagh ke kaam badal kar mizaaj, idraak, shaoor aur rawayya badalne wali dawa, maslan alcohol, caffeine, nicotine aur cocaine, heroin jaisi ghair qanooni drugs.
Narcotic drug: dard ke liye opioid dawa jis mein addiction aur abuse ka bara khatra hai, maslan morphine, codeine, oxycodone. Tamam narcotics psychoactive hain magar har psychoactive narcotic nahi.

(ii) 'Use' tibbi maqsad ke liye darust ya tajweez karda istemal hai. 'Abuse' psychoactive drugs ka ghalat istemal hai; is se aksar dependence (kaam ke liye dawa par jismani ya jazbati inhisar) aur phir addiction hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A narcotic drug (or simply narcotic) is a type of opioid drug

blocks.prompt:
20 Explain the changes in the nervous system (at the dopamine synapse) during drug use, tolerance and withdrawal. (4 marks)
(Drug ke istemal, tolerance aur withdrawal ke dauran nervous system (dopamine synapse) mein tabdeeliyan bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Nasha-awar drugs dimagh ke khushi aur motivation wale hisson par asar karti hain.
1. Istemal: drug dimagh tak pohanchne par presynaptic neurons dopamine nikalte hain jo khushi aur inaam ka ehsas deta hai. Drug molecules presynaptic neuron ke dopamine wapas jazb karne wale receptors band kar dete hain, is liye cleft mein bohat sa dopamine jama ho jata hai.
2. Tolerance: dimagh dhal kar postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors kam kar deta hai. Ab wohi khushi zyada khurak se milti hai; addiction barhti hai.
3. Withdrawal: drug achanak band karne par dopamine normal nikalta hai magar kam receptors ki wajah se postsynaptic neuron kam uksaya jata hai. Is se withdrawal symptoms: ulti, sar dard, be-khwabi, saans ki dushwari, depression, zehni be-qarari aur dauray.

book_ref.quote: Addictive drugs affect the regions of brain which regulate pleasure and motivation

blocks.prompt:
21 Describe the source, mode of use and effects of heroin, cannabis, alcohol and inhalants. (4 marks)
(Heroin, cannabis, alcohol aur inhalants ka mamba, istemal ka tareeqa aur asraat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Heroin: opium poppy se bani sakht nasha-awar opioid; injection, dhuan ya naak se. Jhooti khushi aur sukoon deti aur jaldi dependence aur addiction. Asraat: saans ka dab jana, infections, zehni amraz.
2. Cannabis: Indian hemp Cannabis sativa ke sookhe phool, patte aur tana (marijuana, hashish); dhuan, bhaap ya khane mein. Sukoon, khushi, badla idraak aur bhook. Lamba arsa: zehni kamzori, saans ke masail, zehni amraz.
3. Alcohol: beer, wine, spirits; sukoon aur khushi. Asraat: zehni aur harkati kamzori, jigar ki bimari, dil ki bimari, zehni amraz.
4. Inhalants: nail polish remover, glue; soongh kar khushi, sukoon aur badla idraak. Asraat: saans ke masail, zehni kamzori aur aasab ka nuqsan.

22 What is a stroke? Describe its types and treatment. (4 marks)
(Stroke kya hai? Is ki qismein aur ilaj bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Stroke dimagh ke kisi hisse ki khoon ki farahmi rukne se brain cells ka nuqsan hai, jo nali band hone ya phatne se hota hai. Yeh nervous system ki vascular kharabi hai.

Qismein:
1. Ischemic stroke: dimagh ki naliyan tang ya band.
2. Haemorrhagic stroke: dimagh ki nali risti ya phat-ti hai.
3. Transient ischemic attack (ministroke): dimagh ke hisse ki khoon ki farahmi mein aarzi kami, jo sirf paanch minute bhi reh sakti hai.

Ilaj (jitna jaldi ho sake taake nuqsan kam ho):
1. Dawaen: khoon patla karne wali, lothra ghulane wali ya blood pressure kam karne wali.
2. Surgery: lothra nikalna ya phati nali theek karna.
3. Rehabilitation: jismani aur zehni salahiyat wapas lane ke liye.

book_ref.quote: A stroke means damage in brain cells due to interruption in the blood supply to a part of brain

blocks.prompt:
23 Disorders of the nervous system may be functional. (i) What are functional disorders? (ii) Describe headache, its kinds, migraine and treatment. (4 marks)
(Nervous system ki kharabiyan functional bhi hoti hain. (i) Functional kharabiyan kya hain? (ii) Sar dard, is ki qismein, migraine aur ilaj bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Functional kharabiyan kisi zahiri banawati ya uzvi sabab ke baghair nervous system ke aam kaam ko mutasir karti hain, maslan sar dard.

(ii) Sar dard aam halat hai jis mein sar ya gardan mein dard ya takleef hoti hai.
1. Primary: khud sar dard ki wajah se, kisi aur sabab se nahi, maslan migraine aur tension headache.
2. Secondary: sar ya gardan ke kisi banawati masle se, jaise dimagh mein khoon behna, tumour ya meningitis.
Migraine: sar ke aik taraf ya aik hisse mein shadeed dhak-dhak karta dard, dimagh aur khoon ki naliyon ki tabdeeli se sozish aur dard.
Ilaj: dard kush (analgesic) dawaen, dabao kam karna, baqaida warzish aur neend behtar karna.

book_ref.quote: Headache is a common condition characterized by pain or discomfort in head or neck

blocks.prompt:
24 What are degenerative disorders of the nervous system? Describe Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, multiple sclerosis and Alzheimer's disease. (4 marks)
(Nervous system ki degenerative kharabiyan kya hain? Parkinson's, Huntington's, multiple sclerosis aur Alzheimer's bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Degenerative kharabiyan woh halatein hain jin mein brain, spinal cord ya peripheral nerves ke nerve cells dheere dheere kharab hote hain.
1. Parkinson's: dopamine banane wale brain neurons ki maut ya kamzori, jis se harkat ke masail aur zehni tabdeeliyan.
2. Huntington's: brain neurons ka barhta nuqsan, jis se harkat ki kharabi, zehni zawal aur nafsiyati alamaat.
3. Multiple sclerosis: CNS ki autoimmune bimari jis mein myelin sheath kharab hoti hai; nazar ki kami, dard, thakan aur harkat ki bad-intezami.
4. Alzheimer's: barhti degenerative bimari jo yaad-dasht, soch aur rawayye ko mutasir kar ke boorhon mein dementia laati hai. Wajah genetic, mahol aur tarz-e-zindagi ke awamil. Alamaat halki bhool aur uljhan se shuru ho kar shadeed zehni kamzori (zabaan, masle hal karna, maanoos kaam) tak. Ilaj nahi, magar dawaen raftar kam aur yaad-dasht behtar karti hain.

book_ref.quote: These are the conditions in which there is progressive deterioration of nerve cells

blocks.prompt:
25 Nervous disorders are diagnosed by tests. (i) Describe the procedure of EEG. (ii) Describe the procedure of a CT scan. (4 marks)
(Nervous kharabiyon ki tashkhees tests se hoti hai. (i) EEG ka tareeqa-e-kaar bayan karein. (ii) CT scan ka tareeqa-e-kaar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) EEG neurons ke darmiyan impulses pakar kar dimagh ki barqi sargarmi napta hai.
1. Khopri (scalp) par metal electrodes lagaye jate hain.
2. Electrodes amplifier se jure hote hain jo un ke signals bara karta hai.
3. Signals record ho kar computer screen ya kaghaz par lehron ki shakal mein dikhaye jate hain.
Yeh be-dard hai aur sedation ya anaesthesia nahi chahiye.

(ii) CT X-rays aur computer processing istemal karta hai; tissues X-rays mukhtalif had tak jazb karte hain.
1. Mareez motor wali mez par letta hai jo doughnut numa machine gantry mein jati hai.
2. Gantry ki X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai.
3. Doosri taraf ke detectors mukhtalif tissues se X-rays ka jazb hona record karte hain.
4. Computer is se andaruni hisson ki tafseeli cross-sectional tasveer banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Procedure: During EEG, metal electrodes are attached to the scalp
